_comment: Tier-2 for kratos structural_dynamics: FALSIFIES the pre-2026-08-03 catalog claim that a wrong Bossak key name is 'silently ignored and the scheme runs without damping'. Kratos Parameters::ValidateAndAssignDefaults rejects unknown keys, so a real dynamic StructuralMechanicsAnalysis with 'alpha_m' instead of 'damp_factor_m' aborts with 'Error: The item with name "alpha_m" is present in this Parameters but NOT in the default values' before the first time step, while the same case with 'damp_factor_m' runs to completion. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 on Kratos 10.4.0.
